svg.title: L4 Detail -- DFE on AWS, network
svg.desc: Edge clients reach the cluster's nodes through the receiver's Network Load Balancer, or the optional tunnel forwarder, in the public subnets. The nodes and the Amazon MSK brokers sit in the private subnets. S3 traffic leaves through a gateway endpoint, and traffic for a managed Kafka outside AWS through the NAT gateway. The EKS control plane is AWS-managed, outside the VPC.
